name: App auth token
description: The token returned by the client credentials grant, usable only for endpoints that use App Authentication.

blockers.summary: The token endpoint reference gives no response description or example for the client_credentials grant, so the app auth token's form and lifetime are undocumented.
The token's string form would need a client_credentials request with a real app secret, which is not made here.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
